title_en: Visions of the Future (14/20): Fallout Shelters in the Backyard
note_en: 一…就… links two actions so that the second follows the first immediately, like English "as soon as" or "the moment": 一听到警报声，就立刻躲到桌子底下 "the moment they heard the siren, they dove under their desks." Note that 一 and 就 each sit right before a verb, inside their own clauses, and the subject can come before either: 乌龟伯特一看到闪光，就…躲进自己的壳里 "the moment Bert sees a flash, he pulls into his shell."
